title: LOOK!
skill_description: Visual tracking, handling books, recognizing that print carries meaning. Practice following pictures left to right.
author: FunBookies
summary: A child discovers amazing things by looking carefully at the world around them. A simple pattern book with the word LOOK repeated throughout.
targetPhonics: Single word: LOOK - visual recognition and tracking

parent_tips.before_reading: Hold the book together. Say: Let's look at this book! Point to the title. This word says LOOK. Can you find it?
parent_tips.during_reading: On each page, say LOOK! together, then pause to let your child explore the picture. Ask: What do you see? This builds vocabulary even before reading.
parent_tips.after_reading: Go on a 'LOOK walk' around your home. Say LOOK! and point to interesting things. Let your child say LOOK! too.

comprehension_questions.question: What word do we see on every page?
What did the child look at in the sky?
What animals did we see?
comprehension_questions.answer: An owl, a dog, a bug

comprehension_questions.question: What is your favorite thing to look at?
